New combined /poll endpoint in couriers.py requires JWT and returns availability_status, break_status, should_logout in single response. Frontend CourierDashboard uses 10-second polling interval. root_cause_analysis.issue: Native app location/battery updates were blocked by JWT requirement
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Native app sends location updates directly to backend without going through WebView's axios interceptor, so JWT token was not included
root_cause_analysis.fix_applied: Location endpoint moved from JWT-protected couriers.py to JWT-free courier_native.py. New combined /poll endpoint created to reduce 4 API calls to 1 for performance.
root_cause_analysis.verification: Location endpoint returns 200 without JWT. Poll endpoint returns 401 without JWT, 200 with JWT. Frontend polling works correctly.
